verdict_reason: Publishes every recorded timer value correctly, but gauges and distribution summaries always use Unit.NONE.

todos.issue: readingsOf always builds gauges with Unit.NONE (line 131) and distribution summaries with Unit.NONE (line 128), ignoring Meter.Id.getBaseUnit(). application.yml allowlists jvm.memory.used/committed/max (base unit bytes) and external.call.failure is a 0/1 summary, so CloudWatch receives Bytes metrics as None and the failure summary as None instead of Count; EmfMeterRegistryTest asserts units for timers and counters but not for a bytes gauge or the failure summary.
todos.fix: Must: a gauge or summary is published with the CloudWatch Unit that matches its base unit when CloudWatch knows it (bytes → Bytes, and Count when the meter is a dimensionless count such as external.call.failure); None only when there is no known unit. One way: map id.getBaseUnit() (and treat null/empty count-like summaries as Count) in one helper used by readingsOf, with EmfMeterRegistryTest asserting the unit for a bytes gauge and for external.call.failure.
